response:
The wellbeing principle in the Australian Framework for Generative Artificial Intelligence in Schools outlines that generative AI tools are used to benefit all members of the school community and have a positive impact on their wellbeing. This includes enhancing teaching and learning, human cognition, exposure to diverse perspectives, respecting human rights, and safeguarding individual autonomy - particularly for children.

Additionally, it's stated that generative AI tools do not harm the wellbeing of any members of the school community. The framework also mentions promoting diversity of perspectives to avoid reinforcing existing biases, respecting human rights, and ensuring individual autonomy as key components of this principle.
